answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, since each one must be independent on the trellis graph and each exposes its bond to the wander slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the crystal audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 3 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 37 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
